affinity.notes: The image reads as a physical flesh-and-bone monster without elemental energy.

anatomy.notes: The dangling central tissue merges into the ground trail, obscuring the pelvis and making the lower-body structure ambiguous.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "slow melee bruiser" does not semantically communicate Open-Rib Plague Pump (Specialist) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Massive dragging arms and a top-heavy stance advertise slow, wide-reaching melee swings.

finish.notes: Skin, exposed ribs, wounds, and ground debris are rendered with a consistent grim finish.

framing.notes: The full towering body and extreme arm reach are clearly presented against an uncluttered field.

identity.notes: Blind perception "corpse brute or stitched ogre" semantically identifies rotwalkers/rotwalker-rot-brute.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "elite" is accepted for intended T3 under the documented v2 normalization.
